title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: One Open Delivery & Pickup Services Plan per Patient
content:
A patient holds at most 1 Kestrel Delivery & Pickup Services plan in enrolled, active or past-due status at any one time.

A patient who wants a different delivery plan switches the plan they already hold, where that plan allows switching, rather than enrolling in a second plan. A cancelled plan stays on the patient's profile as history and does not count toward the limit of 1.

## The limit in terms of plan status

| Plans already on the patient's profile | May a further plan be enrolled? |
|---|---|
| None | yes |
| One cancelled plan only | yes (the cancelled plan is history) |
| One plan in enrolled status (free trial) | no |
| One plan in active status | no |
| One plan in past-due status | no |

## Hypothetical profiles

- A patient holds Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly in active status and asks to take Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual as well. The profile already carries 1 open plan, so a second plan is not enrolled; the monthly pass allows switching, and a change of plan is made as a switch of the plan already held.
- A patient's Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery plan was cancelled last year and they now wish to enroll in Kestrel Mail Delivery. The cancelled plan is history, the count of open plans is 0, and the new enrollment is within the limit.
